title: F-16V / F-16 Block 70/72 Viper

sources.title: General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon variants (Wikipedia)
JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The F-16V (new-built as Block 70/72, or older F-16s upgraded, for example in Taiwan) is the newest F-16 standard. Its side-stick, throttle, keypad and consoles are those of the Block 50 that DCS models, so this guide follows the DCS F-16C. The differences are mostly inside: an AESA radar (APG-83, a radar that steers its beam electronically), a newer mission computer and Auto-GCAS, a system that pulls the jet up by itself when it is about to fly into the ground. A large extra screen, the Center Pedestal Display, sits under the glareshield between the two small screens and shows the map and sensor pictures; the catalog has no own item for it yet.
